d: Bombay’s first feared don Karim Lala. A Pathan who arrived from Afghanistan searching for his brother, but ended up ruling the streets of Mumbai. This episode of Tarikh traces the extraordinary rise of Karim Lala — from a railway porter at VT Station to the powerful leader of the Pathan gang. The story explores Bombay’s underworld in the 1940s–80s, his alliance with Haji Mastan, his fearsome reputation, the legendary golden-handled cane, and his links with film stars, politicians, and even Dawood Ibrahim’s family. A gripping tale of power, loyalty, crime, fear, and the making of Mumbai’s…
